semantic_source.rule: The proposals are the semantic source of truth. This model structures their content for deterministic rendering and must never introduce a parallel concept.

summary_line.zh: 城市在变化中保持开放。
summary_line.en: THE CITY STAYS OPEN WHILE IT CHANGES.

proposition.zh: 每一道临时工程，必须预演并留下至少一项永久公共收益。
proposition.en: Every temporary work must rehearse and leave at least one permanent public benefit.

safety_line.zh: 开放的是信息、监督与安全隔离后的公共缓冲，不是施工危险区。
safety_line.en: Open means open to scrutiny, never open access to a work zone.

truth_policy.zh: 官方事实、可核公开背景、待核假设、设计建议四级分开；公开新闻不能替代法定红线，概念几何不能表达已批准工程。
truth_policy.en: Official facts, verifiable public background, assumptions to verify, and design proposals remain separate. News never replaces statutory geometry, and concept geometry never implies approval.

deliver.zh: 独立隔离、连续照明、无障碍且有独立疏散的替代路线；学校、医疗和基本服务替代方案。
deliver.en: A separated, continuously lit, accessible diversion with independent egress, plus continuity plans for schools, healthcare, and essential services.

boundary.zh: 与施工车流和作业面硬隔离；纸面、电话和现场人员路径常开。
boundary.en: Hard separation from works traffic and production areas; paper, telephone, and staffed channels remain available.

handover.zh: 原通路恢复或永久路线通过无障碍与安全核验。
handover.en: The original route is restored or the permanent route passes accessibility and safety audits.

deliver.zh: 可观看、可讨论的模型、样板和公告缓冲区。
deliver.en: A buffer for models, mock-ups, notices, observation, and discussion.

boundary.zh: 公众不进入生产区；展示系统不替代法定监测与安全管理。
boundary.en: The public never enters production zones; displays never replace statutory monitoring or safety management.

handover.zh: 临时设施拆除、转用或进入共享构件库。
handover.en: Temporary facilities are removed, repurposed, or accepted into the shared component library.

deliver.zh: 临时投入的永久去向、运营人、经费、缺陷责任期和证据包。
deliver.en: A permanent destination, operator, funding route, defects period, and evidence pack for every temporary investment.

boundary.zh: 未明确接收人的公共收益不得计入承诺。
boundary.en: A public benefit without a named receiver cannot count as a commitment.

handover.zh: 现场走查、缺陷关闭、接收人签认并公开状态。
handover.en: Site walk-through, defect closure, receiver sign-off, and public status.

common_section.zh: 专业危险区 → 经批准施工边界/硬质围挡 → 独立禁停缓冲 → 连续公众通道 → 活动/服务舱
common_section.en: PROFESSIONAL HAZARD ZONE → APPROVED WORKS BOUNDARY / HARD HOARDING → NO-STOP BUFFER → CONTINUOUS PUBLIC ROUTE → ACTIVITY / SERVICE CABIN

rule.zh: 危险距离由施工组织与专项风险评估确定；任一边界、疏散或人车冲突状态不明，公众激活均关闭。
rule.en: Hazard distances come from construction planning and project risk assessment. If boundary, egress, or people–vehicle conflict status is unknown, public activation stays closed.

spatial_framework.formula: 1 MAP + 1 THREE-LAYER START-WORK CONTRACT + 3 FIELDS + 2 WINGS

wings.zh: 中关村科技服务翼：BIM、合规、保险、算力、采购和创业服务
wings.en: ZHONGGUANCUN SERVICES WING: BIM, compliance, insurance, compute, procurement, venture support

wings.zh: 小月河场景翼：经许可的滨水、生态和公共服务低风险验证
wings.en: XIAOYUE RIVER SCENARIO WING: permitted low-risk waterfront, ecology, and public-service trials

action.zh: 一条清晰、遮护、照明、无障碍且独立疏散的替代路线
action.en: A legible, sheltered, lit, accessible substitute route with independent egress

formal_interface.zh: 正式道路红线、消防疏散和轨道保护条件
formal_interface.en: Formal road redline, fire/egress, and rail-protection conditions

action.zh: 人车分流、等候、转弯视距与人工指挥
action.en: People/vehicle separation, waiting, turning sightline, and human marshal

formal_interface.zh: 纳入施工交通组织；AI无独立放行权
formal_interface.en: Part of construction traffic planning; AI has no independent release authority

action.zh: 经对口部门/正式运营人授权的导航、预约/转介、取送、卫生间或商户连续性载体；不承载诊断、资格、审批或补偿决定
action.en: A carrier authorised by the competent body/formal operator for navigation, booking/referral, pickup, toilet, or merchant continuity; it carries no diagnosis, eligibility, approval, or compensation decision

formal_interface.zh: 授权、用地许可、接电排水、运营、隐私与撤除责任
formal_interface.en: Authorisation, land permission, utilities, operation, privacy, and removal responsibility

action.zh: 模型、样板、公告、观察窗和工人休息界面
action.en: Models, mock-ups, notices, observation window, and worker-rest interface

formal_interface.zh: 与作业区硬隔离，消防与人群控制通过
formal_interface.en: Hard-separated from work; fire and crowd control pass

action.zh: 可复用铺装、树池、座椅、遮棚和数据接口
action.en: Reusable paving, tree pits, seating, shelter, and data interface

formal_interface.zh: 采购前指定永久位置或共享库接收人
formal_interface.en: Name permanent location or shared-depot receiver before procurement

sequence.zh: 既有获准入口 → 纸面7/30/90变化牌 → 依法公开或获授权的生态/水务数据解释点 → 人工服务联络与退出
sequence.en: Existing authorised entrance → paper 7/30/90 change board → interpretation point for lawfully public or authorised ecology/water data → staffed service contact and exit

boundary.zh: 无水务、生态、岸线权属与设施许可，不在岸线安装设备，只在P2公共模型室演示；全程低风险且可退出。
boundary.en: Without water, ecology, waterfront-title, and facility permissions, install nothing on the bank and demonstrate only in the P2 Public Model Room; the path remains low-risk and opt-out throughout.

day_7.zh: 由责任人核验并发布未来7日已知影响与不确定性
day_7.en: Responsible owner verifies and publishes known impacts and uncertainty for the next seven days

emergency.zh: 紧急变化由有权现场责任人依获批信息发布程序即时告知，并保留纸面告示
emergency.en: The competent site owner communicates urgent changes immediately through the approved information-release procedure and retains a paper notice

zh: 哪项承诺进入永久移交

self_award_prohibited.zh: 城市保持开放标记不能由项目自评授予。
self_award_prohibited.en: A project cannot self-award the Keep-the-City-Open mark.

principle.zh: 能力接口，不作项目承诺。

potential_partners: Beijing AI Native Industry Accelerator Area

boundary.zh: 仅在各方授权后逐项登记；无登记授权不称项目、预算、数据共享或空间落位。
boundary.en: Register item by item only after all-party authorisation; without it, claim no project, budget, data sharing, or spatial siting.

mechanism.zh: 以“测量—建设—移交”的可核工程文化组织连续性、公众理解与永久接收。
mechanism.en: Use verifiable survey–build–handover culture to organise continuity, public understanding, and permanent reception.

mechanism.zh: 连续通路、公共模型室、线下等价服务和不断档街区先服务通勤、就医、经营与知情。
mechanism.en: Continuous routes, the public model room, equivalent offline service, and the stay-open district first serve commuting, healthcare, business, and the right to know.

mechanism.zh: 隔离1:1验证、专业签认、有限采购/部署与失败知识回流连接研究、建造、运营和社区。
mechanism.en: Isolated full-scale tests, professional sign-off, limited procurement/deployment, and failure feedback link research, construction, operation, and community.

mechanism.zh: 众智园SC-07—09形成机器人急停、失联、缺陷识别的实验室—隔离验证—人工验收链。
mechanism.en: Zhongzhiyuan SC-07–09 creates a lab–isolated-test–human-acceptance chain for E-stop, link loss, and defect detection.

mechanism.zh: 土地、空间、产业、资金、人才、算力、数据、场景八要素与科技服务翼提供合规、保险、采购和开源/IP接口。
mechanism.en: Eight factors—land, space, industry, funding, talent, compute, data, scenarios—and the services wing provide compliance, insurance, procurement, and open-source/IP interfaces.

mechanism.zh: SC-01—12均绑定真实空间、十字段台账、停止条件、回滚和可删除数据。
mechanism.en: Every SC-01–12 binds a real interface to a ten-field ledger, stop condition, rollback, and deletable data.

mechanism.zh: 公共模型室、不断档街区与条件性场景翼优先保证无障碍、基本服务和自愿商业试验。
mechanism.en: The Public Model Room, Stay-Open District, and conditional scenario wing prioritise accessibility, essential services, and voluntary business trials.

mechanism.zh: G0—G8、仅在法律/合同/事件响应协议允许范围内公开的去标识失败档案、申诉、人工接管和接收签认形成可复核治理语言。
mechanism.en: G0–G8, de-identified failure records disclosed only where law, contract, and incident-response protocol permit, appeal, human takeover, and receiver sign-off form an auditable governance language.

name.zh: 轮椅使用者、低视力通勤者

need.zh: 连续坡道、触觉与语音信息、无障碍绕行
need.en: Continuous ramps, tactile/audio information, accessible diversion

decision_right.zh: 参与代表性路线走查并可提出不开放建议；有权责任人记录、答复并按规范决定
decision_right.en: Participates in representative route walk-throughs and may recommend no opening; the competent owner records, answers, and decides under applicable standards

need.zh: 短距离、休息点、线下通知与人工帮助
need.en: Short distance, rest points, offline notice, and human help

decision_right.en: Participates in day and night walk-throughs

need.zh: 上学时段安全、施工车错峰、明确监护界面
need.en: Safe school times, staggered construction traffic, clear safeguarding interface

need.zh: 门前可达、装卸、客流告知与自愿参与
need.en: Front-door access, loading, customer notice, and voluntary participation

decision_right.zh: 决定是否加入经营试点并可随时退出
decision_right.en: Decides whether to join the trading pilot and may leave at any time

name.zh: 骑手、快递与网约车司机

need.zh: 清晰临停、取送和不逆行的接驳
need.en: Legible short stay, pickup/delivery, and connection without wrong-way movement

need.zh: 安全、休息、培训与不被算法绩效监控
need.en: Safety, rest, training, and no algorithmic productivity surveillance

decision_right.zh: 拥有人工作业停机和匿名报告渠道
decision_right.en: Has manual stop and anonymous reporting channels

need.zh: 清楚边界、应急和设备状态
need.en: Clear boundaries, emergencies, and equipment status

decision_right.zh: 在其法定/合同职责范围内对作业和公众开放拥有停权
decision_right.en: Holds stop authority over work and public opening within statutory/contractual duties

need.zh: 合规、成本、责任与长期接收能力
need.en: Compliance, cost, responsibility, and long-term acceptance capacity

decision_right.zh: 对本项目承担最终责任
decision_right.en: Holds final responsibility for its project

name.zh: 高校研究者与创业团队

need.zh: 可测试、可复现实验与明确数据边界
need.en: Testability, reproducibility, and explicit data boundaries

decision_right.zh: 只能在批准协议内操作
decision_right.en: Operates only inside an approved protocol

name.zh: 国际短驻团队与开源维护者
name.en: International short-stay team and open-source maintainer

need.zh: 多语到达、无障碍短驻工位、开源/IP边界、安静工作与日常服务导航
need.en: Multilingual arrival, accessible short-stay workspace, open-source/IP boundaries, quiet work, and daily-service navigation

decision_right.zh: 可拒绝进入数据试验并退出；不据此承诺签证、住房或补贴
decision_right.en: May refuse data trials and leave; this creates no visa, housing, or subsidy promise

offer.zh: 受控研发、1:1试验与工人培训
offer.en: Controlled R&D, full-scale tests, and worker training

offer.zh: 高校连接、公共模型室与开源协作
offer.en: University links, Public Model Room, and open-source collaboration

offer.zh: 自愿商业服务、维修与日常交往
offer.en: Voluntary commerce, repair, and everyday encounter

place.zh: 遗址公园、小月河与科技服务翼
place.en: Heritage Park, Xiaoyue River, and services wing

offer.zh: 无广告步行休憩、法务保险、成果转化与多语支持
offer.en: Ad-free walking/rest, legal/insurance, transfer, and multilingual support

boundary.zh: 短驻、托育、住宿和生活服务只登记经核的现有供给与缺口；不先画新建筑，不承诺招商、签证、住房或补贴。
boundary.en: Short-stay carriers, childcare, lodging, and daily services record only verified existing provision and gaps; no pre-drawn buildings or recruitment, visa, housing, or subsidy promises.

resource.zh: 南段恢复的约2.4公里旧轨；四道口蒸汽车头与绿皮车厢；笑祖塔焊轨厂龙门吊
resource.en: About 2.4 km of restored historic rail in the southern section; Sidaokou steam locomotive and green rail car; Xiaozuta welding-works gantry crane

action.zh: 以轨距—构件—验收组织1:1工程学习，不移动原物
action.en: Use gauge–component–acceptance to structure full-scale engineering learning; move no artefact

rights_check.zh: 实物清单、位置、权属、保护等级、荷载与公众安全
rights_check.en: Asset list, location, ownership, designation, load, and public safety

resource.zh: 京张之环、铁路部门捐赠老式油罐车、道岔、候车长椅及历史图文
resource.en: Jingzhang Ring, railway-donated historic tanker, switches, waiting benches, and historical panels

action.zh: 既有展陈与7/30/90日工程知识并置，不仿制假古董
action.en: Place existing interpretation beside 7/30/90-day works knowledge; fabricate no fake antique

rights_check.zh: 捐赠/运营边界、图像与文字版权、维护责任
rights_check.en: Donation/operation boundary, image/text rights, and maintenance owner

resource.zh: 科创市集、文化快闪、学校与高校研学等公开活动背景
resource.en: Reported science markets, cultural pop-ups, and school/university field learning

action.zh: 建议失败档案、移交同行走查与工法讲解，不宣称既定活动
action.en: Propose failure archives, handover walk-throughs, and construction-method interpretation; claim no confirmed event

rights_check.zh: 真实年度计划、容量、噪声、消防、保险和主办授权
rights_check.en: Actual annual programme, capacity, noise, fire, insurance, and host approval

resource.zh: 约9公里日常通勤、休闲与社区连接功能
resource.en: About 9 km of everyday commuting, recreation, and community connection

action.zh: 文化首先体现为持续可走、可读、可使用的公共空间
action.en: Express culture first as public space that remains walkable, readable, and usable

rights_check.zh: 现状客流、无障碍断点、树木/排水、活动冲突和运营时段
rights_check.en: Existing flows, accessibility breaks, trees/drainage, event conflict, and hours

name.zh: 众智园AI自主创新加速区

program.zh: 受控试验格、构件库、人工接管位、观察缓冲和工人培训室。
program.en: Controlled test bay, component library, manual takeover station, observation buffer, and worker training room.

envelope.zh: 约20×20米模块化隔离试验单元；仅为概念包络。
envelope.en: Approx. 20 × 20 m modular isolated test unit; concept envelope only.

rollback.zh: 失败即断能、人工接管、隔离批次并封存证据。
rollback.en: On failure: de-energise, take over manually, isolate the batch, and preserve evidence.

program.zh: 1:200实体模型、无障碍数字台、变化墙、安静咨询室和移动样板台。
program.en: 1:200 physical model, accessible digital table, change wall, quiet consultation room, and mobile mock-up bench.

envelope.zh: 优先复用一处约80—150平方米可达首层空间；仅为概念包络。
envelope.en: Prefer reuse of an accessible 80–150 sqm ground-floor space; concept envelope only.

rollback.zh: 无法落位则用可移动模型开展异地会审。
rollback.en: If siting fails, use a mobile model for an off-site joint review.

program.zh: 连续骑楼式遮护、商户服务舱、配送口袋区和条件性四象限到达提示。
program.en: Continuous sheltered frontage, merchant service cabins, delivery pockets, and conditional four-quadrant arrival cues.

envelope.zh: 一条经核验的无障碍通路与3—5家自愿商户/服务点；仅为概念包络。
envelope.en: One verified accessible route with 3–5 voluntary businesses/service points; concept envelope only.

rollback.zh: 无真实工期、商户同意或交通审查时，转异地全尺度演练。
rollback.en: Without a real programme, merchant consent, and traffic review, switch to an off-site full-scale rehearsal.

rule.zh: 高风险技术留在受控边界，公众只在缓冲层观看。
rule.en: High-risk technology stays inside the controlled boundary; observation is buffer-side only.

rule.zh: 模型桌显示谁提议、谁有权决定、当前状态及理由。
rule.en: A model table shows who proposed, who holds decision authority, the current status, and the reasons.

rule.zh: 围挡、遮护、照明、服务舱与商户入口形成同一街道界面。
rule.en: Hoarding, shelter, lighting, service cabins, and merchant entries form one street interface.

rule.zh: 只展示接收人已签认的永久收益；未完成事项显示责任人与期限。
rule.en: Display only permanent benefits signed by a receiver; incomplete items show their owner and due date.

field.zh: 全线接口；轮椅、行人与骑行者
field.en: Belt interfaces; wheelchair users, pedestrians, cyclists

ai.zh: 边缘计数只提示拥堵，不采人脸
ai.en: Edge counts flag crowding; no face capture

owner_non_ai.zh: 现场经理；纸图、路牌和引导员常开
owner_non_ai.en: Site manager; paper map, signs, and stewards remain active

test_stop_rollback.zh: 日夜及轮椅走查；断链、积水或疏散受阻即关闭新路并恢复旧路/备用路
test_stop_rollback.en: Day/night and wheelchair audits; any break, flooding, or blocked egress closes the new route and restores the old/backup route

no_ai_baseline.zh: 经批准的静态导视、连续照明、人工引导与纸面巡检表。
no_ai_baseline.en: Approved static signs, continuous lighting, human stewards, and paper audit sheets.

minimum_data.zh: 匿名分时方向计数、通路开闭和积水/照明状态；不采人脸或原始视频。
minimum_data.en: Anonymous time-banded directional counts and route/open/flood/light status; no faces or raw video.

model_metric.zh: 拥堵提示与人工计数的一致性、误报和漏报。
model_metric.en: Agreement, false alerts, and missed alerts against manual counts.

public_service_metric.zh: MET-01.1可用时段与MET-01.2代表性无障碍走查。
public_service_metric.en: MET-01.1 availability and MET-01.2 representative accessibility audit.

compliance_metric.zh: G1/G2通过；公众进入施工边界为0；不采生物识别。
compliance_metric.en: G1/G2 pass; zero public entries into works; no biometric capture.

human_signoff.zh: 现场经理与独立无障碍走查代表签认。
human_signoff.en: Site manager and independent representative accessibility auditor sign.

fail_safe.zh: 关闭新路，恢复经批准的原路或备用路线。
fail_safe.en: Close the new route and restore the approved original or backup route.

retention_deletion.zh: 只保留经批准周期内的聚合计数与事件日志；不形成原始视频库。
retention_deletion.en: Retain aggregate counts and incident logs only for the approved period; create no raw-video archive.

non_ai_route.zh: 纸图、路牌、连续照明、人工引导和现场电话。
non_ai_route.en: Paper map, signs, continuous lighting, stewards, and site telephone.

field.zh: 学校、养老、医疗接口；儿童、老人、患者
field.en: School, eldercare, healthcare interfaces; children, older people, patients

owner_non_ai.zh: 公共服务联络员；电话与人工预约
owner_non_ai.en: Public-service liaison; telephone and staffed booking

test_stop_rollback.zh: 每个服务窗口演练；必要服务不可达时，触发有权现场责任人按批准方案暂停相应作业或启用获批等价替代
test_stop_rollback.en: Rehearse every service window; if essential service becomes unavailable, the competent site owner follows the approved plan to pause the relevant activity or activate an approved equivalent substitute

no_ai_baseline.zh: 既有服务窗口、人工排班、电话预约和纸面应急联系表。
no_ai_baseline.en: Existing service windows, human staffing, telephone booking, and paper emergency contacts.

minimum_data.zh: 服务开闭、匿名分时到达量和已同意的服务时窗；不采资格或病历。
minimum_data.en: Service status, anonymous time-banded arrivals, and agreed service windows; no eligibility or medical records.

model_metric.zh: 高峰预测误差与人工排班基线比较。
model_metric.en: Peak-prediction error against the human staffing baseline.

public_service_metric.zh: MET-01.3每项必要服务有原服务或等价替代。
public_service_metric.en: MET-01.3: every essential service retains the original or an equivalent alternative.

compliance_metric.en: G1/G5/G8 pass; AI makes no service-eligibility decision.

human_signoff.zh: 对口服务运营人和公共服务联络员逐窗口签认。
human_signoff.en: Responsible service operator and public-service liaison sign each window.

fail_safe.zh: 由有权现场责任人依批准方案暂停受影响活动或启用获批等价替代，并恢复原/备用服务。
fail_safe.en: The competent site owner follows the approved plan to pause the affected activity or activate an approved equivalent substitute, restoring the original/backup service.

retention_deletion.zh: 聚合排班数据按批准服务周期保存；不保存资格、诊疗或个体轨迹。
retention_deletion.en: Aggregate staffing data follows the approved service period; retain no eligibility, clinical, or individual-journey data.

non_ai_route.zh: 人工窗口、电话预约、纸面时刻与现场联络员。
non_ai_route.en: Staffed window, telephone booking, paper timetable, and on-site liaison.

field.zh: 工地车门；司机、行人、骑手

ai.zh: 盲区告警辅助人工指挥

owner_non_ai.zh: 交通疏导员最终放行；手旗和信号灯备用
owner_non_ai.en: Traffic marshal releases movement; flags and signals back up

test_stop_rollback.zh: 模拟失联和误报；高潜势险情触发关门、复盘，并由有权责任人依适用安全协议重新批准
test_stop_rollback.en: Simulate dropout and false alerts; a high-potential incident closes the gate, triggers review, and requires re-approval by the competent owner under the applicable safety protocol

no_ai_baseline.zh: 人工疏导员、闭门程序、手旗、信号灯和固定视距检查。
no_ai_baseline.en: Human marshal, gate-closed procedure, flags, signals, and fixed sightline check.

minimum_data.zh: 设备在线状态、匿名目标区占用和事件时间戳；不采人脸或车牌。
minimum_data.en: Device health, anonymous conflict-zone occupancy, and incident timestamps; no faces or number plates.

model_metric.zh: 盲区告警召回、误报、延迟与失联发现时间。
model_metric.en: Blind-spot recall, false alerts, latency, and link-loss detection time.

public_service_metric.zh: 行人/骑行等待与必要通行不中断。
public_service_metric.en: Pedestrian/cycle waiting and uninterrupted essential passage.

compliance_metric.zh: G2通过；AI放行次数为0；高潜势险情全部记录。
compliance_metric.en: G2 pass; zero AI releases; every high-potential incident logged.

human_signoff.zh: 交通疏导员最终放行；现场经理复核事件关闭；重新开启由有权责任人依协议批准。
human_signoff.en: Traffic marshal releases movement; site manager signs incident closure; the competent owner approves reopening under the protocol.

fail_safe.zh: 车辆门关闭、人工接管、复盘并重新批准。
fail_safe.en: Close the vehicle gate, take over manually, review, and re-approve.

retention_deletion.zh: 安全事件日志按批准安全计划保存；默认不保存可识别人车影像。
retention_deletion.en: Safety event logs follow the approved safety plan; identifiable people/vehicle imagery is not retained by default.

non_ai_route.zh: 人工疏导员、手旗、信号灯、对讲与闭门。
non_ai_route.en: Human marshal, flags, signals, radio, and gate closure.

ai.zh: 冲突检测提示叠加影响

owner_non_ai.zh: 项目业主签字；纸面公告与电话同步
owner_non_ai.en: Project owner signs; paper notice and telephone run in parallel

test_stop_rollback.zh: 每周核对；未核状态不得发布，错误立即更正并留痕
test_stop_rollback.en: Weekly verification; unverified status is not published and errors are corrected with an audit trail

no_ai_baseline.zh: 业主签字的表格/日历、纸面公告、电话和每周人工变化会。
no_ai_baseline.en: Owner-signed spreadsheet/calendar, paper notice, telephone, and weekly human change meeting.

minimum_data.zh: 经核项目里程碑、影响接口、责任人、状态与时间戳；不含个人轨迹。
minimum_data.en: Verified milestones, affected interfaces, owner, status, and timestamp; no individual journeys.

model_metric.zh: 冲突提示相对人工会审的正确率、漏报和陈旧率。
model_metric.en: Conflict correctness, misses, and staleness against human joint review.

public_service_metric.zh: MET-03.1告知正确性与7/30/90日完整率。

compliance_metric.zh: G0/G5通过；每条公开状态有业主与时间戳。
compliance_metric.en: G0/G5 pass; every public status has an owner and timestamp.

human_signoff.zh: 具体项目业主签字；跨项目冲突由依托现有机制的建议性秘书处提示会审。
human_signoff.en: Project owner signs; the advisory secretariat through existing mechanisms flags cross-project joint review.

fail_safe.zh: 撤下未核状态，发布更正，保留版本并恢复纸面/电话渠道。
fail_safe.en: Withdraw unverified status, publish correction, retain version trail, and restore paper/telephone channels.

retention_deletion.zh: 版本化变更记录按批准治理周期留存；关闭后删除非必要工作副本。
retention_deletion.en: Versioned change records follow the approved governance period; delete unnecessary working copies after closure.

non_ai_route.zh: 纸面影响表、电话、现场公告和人工变化会。
non_ai_route.en: Paper impact sheet, telephone, site notice, and human change meeting.

field.zh: 住宅/学校邻接；居民与工人

ai.zh: 异常趋势提示；不替代GB 12523—2025、HJ 1402—2024、人工确认或执法
ai.en: Trend alert only; never replaces GB 12523—2025, HJ 1402—2024, human confirmation, or enforcement

owner_non_ai.zh: 环境负责人；法定/人工监测、巡检与热线
owner_non_ai.en: Environmental lead; statutory/manual monitoring, inspections, and hotline

test_stop_rollback.zh: 与法定设备校核；漂移或断线即标不可用，转法定/人工监测、巡检和责任主体处置
test_stop_rollback.en: Cross-check statutory equipment; drift/dropout marks the display unavailable and switches to statutory/manual monitoring, inspection, and responsible-body response

no_ai_baseline.zh: 适用法定监测、人工巡检、热线与责任主体处置。
no_ai_baseline.en: Applicable statutory monitoring, manual inspection, hotline, and responsible-body response.

minimum_data.zh: 校准状态、合规声级摘要、设备健康和去标识工单；不录原始音频。
minimum_data.en: Calibration status, compliant level summaries, device health, and de-identified tickets; no raw audio.

model_metric.zh: 异常提示相对法定/人工读数的偏差、漂移、误报和漏报。
model_metric.en: Deviation, drift, false alerts, and misses against statutory/manual readings.

public_service_metric.zh: MET-03.2投诉响应、升级和人工关闭。
public_service_metric.en: MET-03.2 complaint response, escalation, and human closure.

compliance_metric.zh: G4通过；GB 12523—2025/HJ 1402—2024接口有效；仪表盘始终标非执法。
compliance_metric.en: G4 pass; valid GB 12523—2025/HJ 1402—2024 interface; dashboard always labelled non-enforcement.

human_signoff.zh: 法定责任主体与环境负责人签认；AI不作执法或责任认定。
human_signoff.en: Statutory responsible body and environmental lead sign; AI makes no enforcement or liability finding.

fail_safe.zh: 仪表盘标不可用，转法定/人工监测、巡检和热线处置。
fail_safe.en: Mark dashboard unavailable and switch to statutory/manual monitoring, inspection, and hotline response.

retention_deletion.zh: 监测与工单按适用标准/法定义务保存；原始音频持续为0。
retention_deletion.en: Monitoring and tickets follow applicable standards/legal duties; raw audio remains zero.

non_ai_route.zh: 法定监测、人工巡检、热线、纸面告示和人工答复。
non_ai_route.en: Statutory monitoring, human inspection, hotline, paper notice, and human response.

field.zh: 原点公共模型室；居民、设计师、业主
field.en: Origin Public Model Room; residents, designers, owner

ai.zh: 比较日照、噪声、扬尘、交通与时序备选
ai.en: Compare daylight, noise, dust, mobility, and sequencing options

owner_non_ai.zh: 主持人记录；业主就权限内事项作有理由答复，权限外事项提交有权主体；纸卡可提交
owner_non_ai.en: Facilitator records; owner gives a reasoned response within its authority and submits out-of-scope matters to the competent body; paper cards accepted

test_stop_rollback.zh: 可追溯性审计；缺数据即降级为假设，不用于批准
test_stop_rollback.en: Traceability audit; missing data downgrades output to an assumption and excludes it from approval

no_ai_baseline.zh: 1:200实体模型、纸卡、主持会审与业主书面理由。
no_ai_baseline.en: 1:200 physical model, paper cards, facilitated review, and owner’s written reasons.

minimum_data.zh: 有来源/日期的方案参数、模型版本和自愿意见；个人标识最小化。
minimum_data.en: Sourced/dated option parameters, model versions, and voluntary comments; minimise personal identifiers.

model_metric.zh: 方案比较可复现率、来源完整率和错误更正时间。
model_metric.en: Reproducibility, source completeness, and correction time.

public_service_metric.zh: 公开意见到有理由答复的可追溯率与无障碍参与等价性。
public_service_metric.en: Traceability from comment to reasoned response and equivalent accessible participation.

compliance_metric.zh: G5/G8通过；模型展示不等于同意或批准。
compliance_metric.en: G5/G8 pass; model display is neither consent nor approval.

human_signoff.zh: 主持人记录；具体项目业主仅对权限内事项作有理由答复，权限外事项由有权主体决定。
human_signoff.en: Facilitator records; the project owner gives reasoned responses only within its authority, while the competent body decides out-of-scope matters.

fail_safe.zh: 缺失输入标为假设，撤出审批链，转实体模型与人工会审。
fail_safe.en: Mark missing input as assumption, remove it from approval, and switch to physical model/human review.

retention_deletion.zh: 模型版本和决定理由归档；个人标识在答复/申诉周期后删除。
retention_deletion.en: Archive model versions and decision reasons; delete personal identifiers after the response/appeal period.

non_ai_route.zh: 实体模型、纸卡、安静咨询室、主持人和书面答复。
non_ai_route.en: Physical model, paper cards, quiet consultation, facilitator, and written response.

field.zh: 众智园试验格；工人、研究者
field.en: Zhongzhiyuan test bay; workers and researchers

owner_non_ai.zh: 经试验协议或合同明确授权的独立安全官可物理断能；经批准的手工作业备用
owner_non_ai.en: An independent safety officer explicitly authorised by the test protocol or contract can physically de-energise; the approved manual method is the backup

test_stop_rollback.zh: 空载、假载、实载逐级；越界、异常力或人员侵入立即断能
test_stop_rollback.en: No-load, dummy-load, then live-load; boundary breach, abnormal force, or human intrusion triggers immediate de-energisation

no_ai_baseline.zh: 经批准的手工作业方案、硬隔离、机械锁止和人工观察。
no_ai_baseline.en: Approved manual method, hard isolation, mechanical lockout, and human observation.

minimum_data.zh: 设备状态、力、速度、地理围栏、载荷和急停结果；禁工人效率评分。
minimum_data.en: Machine state, force, speed, geofence, load, and E-stop result; no worker productivity scoring.

model_metric.zh: 越界、异常力、延迟和人工接管响应按批准试验协议。
model_metric.en: Boundary, abnormal-force, latency, and takeover response under the approved test protocol.

public_service_metric.zh: 人员伤害零容忍；公众进入试验格为0。
public_service_metric.en: Zero tolerance for injury; zero public entries into the test bay.

compliance_metric.en: G0/G2/G8 pass; zero AI engineering acceptances.

human_signoff.zh: 经试验协议或合同明确授权的独立安全官与具备相应资格和职责的工程专业人员逐级签认。
human_signoff.en: The protocol/contract-authorised independent safety officer and a competent engineering professional sign each step.

fail_safe.zh: 断能、锁止、人工接管、封存证据并回到手工作业。
fail_safe.en: De-energise, lock out, take over manually, preserve evidence, and return to manual work.

retention_deletion.zh: 试验与安全事件记录按批准安全计划保存；默认不采生物识别。
retention_deletion.en: Test and safety-event records follow the approved safety plan; no biometrics by default.

non_ai_route.zh: 手工作业方案、机械锁止、物理急停和人工撤离。
non_ai_route.en: Manual method, mechanical lockout, physical E-stop, and human evacuation.

field.zh: 众智园试验格；设备团队

ai.en: Monitor latency, location, and link loss

owner_non_ai.zh: 经试验协议或合同明确授权的独立安全官主导；机械锁止和人工撤离
owner_non_ai.en: An independent safety officer explicitly authorised by the test protocol or contract leads; mechanical lockout and human evacuation remain available

test_stop_rollback.zh: 每次软硬件变更后演练；急停或失联保护不通过不得带载
test_stop_rollback.en: Rehearse after every software/hardware change; failed E-stop or link-loss protection forbids live load

no_ai_baseline.zh: 物理急停、机械锁止、人工撤离、对讲和变更后检查表。
no_ai_baseline.en: Physical E-stop, mechanical lockout, human evacuation, radio, and post-change checklist.

minimum_data.zh: 端到端延迟、连接状态、定位、急停触发与安全态；不采人员表现。
minimum_data.en: End-to-end latency, link state, location, E-stop trigger, and safe state; no worker performance data.

model_metric.zh: 急停响应、失联发现和进入安全态时间按批准协议。
model_metric.en: E-stop response, link-loss detection, and safe-state time under the approved protocol.

public_service_metric.zh: 每次变更后通过；未通过不得带载或公众观察。
public_service_metric.en: Pass after every change; failure forbids live load and public observation.

compliance_metric.zh: G2/G8通过；独立见证记录完整。
compliance_metric.en: G2/G8 pass; independent witness record complete.

human_signoff.zh: 经试验协议或合同明确授权的独立安全官主导并签认；现场安全负责人在其法定/合同职责范围内保有停权。
human_signoff.en: The protocol/contract-authorised independent safety officer leads and signs; the site safety lead retains stop authority within statutory/contractual duties.

fail_safe.zh: 物理断能、机械锁止、人工撤离并禁止带载。
fail_safe.en: Physical de-energisation, mechanical lockout, human evacuation, and no live load.

retention_deletion.zh: 变更与演练日志按批准设备安全计划留存；不记录人员排名。
retention_deletion.en: Change/drill logs follow the approved equipment-safety plan; no worker ranking.

non_ai_route.zh: 物理急停、机械锁止、人工撤离和纸面检查表。
non_ai_route.en: Physical E-stop, mechanical lockout, human evacuation, and paper checklist.

field.zh: 构件检验位；工程师、供应商
field.en: Component inspection station; engineers and suppliers

ai.zh: 视觉/传感辅助缺陷检测

owner_non_ai.zh: 具备相应资格与职责的专业人员签认；人工量测为基准
owner_non_ai.en: A professional with the applicable qualification and duty signs; manual measurement is baseline

test_stop_rollback.zh: 盲测误报/漏报；高危漏报即停模、隔离批次、人工全检
test_stop_rollback.en: Blind-test false positives/negatives; a high-risk miss stops the model, isolates the batch, and restores full manual inspection

no_ai_baseline.zh: 注册专业人员按批准检验计划人工量测、抽检/全检与批次隔离。
no_ai_baseline.en: Registered professional follows the approved inspection plan for manual measurement, sampling/full inspection, and batch isolation.

minimum_data.zh: 仅构件图像/量测、批次和专业标注；不含人员影像或商业无关数据。
minimum_data.en: Component-only imagery/measurements, batch, and professional labels; no people or unrelated commercial data.

model_metric.zh: 盲测漏报、误报与置信校准；阈值由合格专业人员批准。
model_metric.en: Blind-test misses, false positives, and calibration; thresholds approved by a competent professional.

public_service_metric.zh: MET-02.2高风险漏报触发硬停，不以速度替代质量。
public_service_metric.en: MET-02.2: a high-risk miss triggers hard stop; speed never substitutes for quality.

compliance_metric.en: G0/G8 pass; zero final AI sign-offs.

human_signoff.zh: 具备相应资格与职责的专业人员签认质量，供应商和业主按合同承担责任。
human_signoff.en: A professional with the applicable qualification and duty signs quality; supplier and owner retain contractual responsibility.

fail_safe.zh: 停用模型、隔离批次并恢复人工全检。
fail_safe.en: Stop the model, isolate the batch, and restore full manual inspection.

retention_deletion.zh: 构件数据按批准质量/缺陷责任计划留存；删除无关标识和工作副本。
retention_deletion.en: Component data follows the approved quality/defects plan; delete unrelated identifiers and working copies.

non_ai_route.zh: 人工量测、批准检验计划、批次隔离与专业签认。
non_ai_route.en: Manual measurement, approved inspection plan, batch isolation, and professional sign-off.

field.zh: 大钟寺接口；商户、顾客、骑手；商户控制的服务舱与取送口袋区
field.en: Dazhongsi interface; merchants, customers, riders; merchant-controlled pod and pickup pocket

ai.zh: 商户自选多语商品说明、库存/配送辅助与维修预约；不作差别定价或敏感画像
ai.en: Merchant-selected multilingual descriptions, stock/delivery assistance, and repair booking; no discriminatory pricing or sensitive profiling

owner_non_ai.zh: 商户控制开关、可退出并要求删除；有人收银、电话、现金、实体菜单及人工取送保留
owner_non_ai.en: Merchant controls the switch, may leave and request deletion; staffed checkout, telephone, cash, physical menus, and human pickup remain

test_stop_rollback.zh: 每日核对可达、营业、误推和数据删除；断网、阻塞消防或经营受损即切回人工、移舱/撤除并停止模型
test_stop_rollback.en: Daily checks of access, trading, misleading output, and deletion; loss of connection, fire obstruction, or trading harm returns to manual, moves/removes the pod, and stops the model

no_ai_baseline.zh: 商户自主说明与备货、有人收银、电话、现金/实体菜单、人工取送和维修登记。
no_ai_baseline.en: Merchant-authored descriptions/stocking, staffed checkout, telephone, cash/physical menus, human pickup, and repair register.

minimum_data.zh: 商户明确授权的商品说明、聚合库存/配送需求、营业状态与维修时窗；禁敏感消费者画像。
minimum_data.en: Merchant-authorised product descriptions, aggregate stock/delivery demand, trading status, and repair windows; no sensitive consumer profiles.

model_metric.zh: 多语说明事实错误、库存/配送提示误差、误推与人工纠正次数。
model_metric.en: Factual errors in multilingual descriptions, stock/delivery cue error, misleading outputs, and human corrections.

public_service_metric.zh: MET-01.4经营/配送可达日；商户退出权、删除请求与人工服务始终有效。
public_service_metric.en: MET-01.4 trading/delivery accessible days; merchant exit/deletion rights and human service remain effective.

compliance_metric.zh: G5/G8通过；消防通道无阻塞；AI差别定价、敏感画像或代商户决定交易次数为0。
compliance_metric.en: G5/G8 pass; no fire obstruction; zero discriminatory pricing, sensitive profiles, or AI-decided transactions.

human_signoff.zh: 自愿商户控制开关并每日确认；现场服务经理核对可达和消防。
human_signoff.en: Voluntary merchant controls the switch and confirms daily; site service manager checks access and fire safety.

fail_safe.zh: 断网、误推或经营受损即停模型、切回人工、按需移舱/撤除。
fail_safe.en: Loss of connection, misleading output, or trading harm stops the model, returns to manual, and moves/removes the pod as needed.

retention_deletion.zh: 只在最短同意周期保存授权商品/聚合运营数据；商户退出或要求删除即停采并删试点工作数据。
retention_deletion.en: Keep authorised product/aggregate operating data only for the shortest consented period; withdrawal or deletion request stops collection and deletes pilot working data.

non_ai_route.zh: 商户人工说明与备货、有人收银、电话、现金、实体菜单、人工取送与维修预约。
non_ai_route.en: Merchant-authored descriptions/stocking, staffed checkout, telephone, cash, physical menus, human pickup, and repair booking.

name.zh: 正式授权基本服务替代

field.zh: 三处重点区及正式运营人授权接口；居民；导航、预约/转介、取送点或卫生间替代
field.en: All three key areas and formally authorised interfaces; residents; navigation, booking/referral, pickup point, or toilet alternative

ai.zh: 排队提示，不作资格、诊断、审批或补偿判断
ai.en: Queue cue only; no eligibility, diagnosis, approval, or compensation decision

owner_non_ai.zh: 对口部门/正式运营人负责；人工窗口和电话可用
owner_non_ai.en: Competent body/formal operator is responsible; staffed window and telephone remain available

test_stop_rollback.zh: 授权与服务等价性走查；隐私、供电或无障碍失败即转回原服务或批准备用方案
test_stop_rollback.en: Authorisation and service-equivalence audit; privacy, power, or accessibility failure restores the original service or approved alternative

no_ai_baseline.zh: 正式运营人授权的原服务/批准备用方案、人工窗口、电话、纸面排队与现场协助。
no_ai_baseline.en: Formal-operator-authorised original service/approved alternative, staffed window, telephone, paper queue, and on-site assistance.

assumptions.statement: No specific project is treated as currently under construction unless its owner, programme, and status are signed.
assumptions.impact: Unverified interfaces remain off-site rehearsals and display as to verify.

assumptions.statement: Land, building, park, and frontage ownership/operating rights are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: No siting, occupation, access, business, or asset-transfer commitment before consent.

assumptions.statement: Works redlines, hoarding, vehicle gates, hazards, emergency routes, and stage plans are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Concept geometry is not a construction layout; G0 fails until verified.

assumptions.statement: It is unknown whether an activity is an Article 19 work inside a legally announced rail-protection area and, where applicable, whether the work unit first prepares safety-protection and monitoring plans, then obtains operator consent, then secures statutory permission, supports any dynamic monitoring/inspection lawfully chosen by the operator, and after completion jointly assesses, files, and removes impacts; existing railway assets and heritage lines require a separate check.
assumptions.impact: Station, under-bridge, and trackside ideas remain off-site simulations; G3 cannot be pre-passed.

assumptions.statement: Approved land use, FAR, height, setbacks, road redlines, parking, heritage, utilities, water, fire, and public-facility controls are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: No statutory capacity or engineering claim; building area/FAR/height remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Cleared building-by-building condition, use, structure, service, tree, drainage, and retain/renovate/demolish surveys are missing.
assumptions.impact: Submitted footprints are concept prototypes only; no object-level demolition or retention decision.

assumptions.statement: Hazard distances and public-buffer dimensions require project-specific professional assessment.
assumptions.impact: No concept distance is offered. Applicable law, approved construction planning, specialist assessment, and formal conditions determine the layout.

assumptions.statement: Day/night/rain, wheelchair, low-vision, school, healthcare, delivery, and emergency continuity baselines are not measured.
assumptions.impact: Targets remain to be set after D16–30 audits; G1 cannot be claimed now.

assumptions.statement: Applicable GB 12523—2025/HJ 1402—2024 monitoring design, equipment, calibration, responsible body, and enforcement route are not assigned.
assumptions.impact: Any public sensor is explanatory only and always labelled non-enforcement.

assumptions.statement: No personal-data processing is authorised; the default is no face, gait, raw video, worker ranking, or eligibility/compensation profiling.
assumptions.impact: Any exception requires a lawful basis, minimisation, retention/deletion rule, security review, non-AI route, and G8 approval.

assumptions.statement: Robot E-stop/link-loss, force/geofence, defect-test datasets, thresholds, and competent signatories are not approved.
assumptions.impact: SC-07–09 stay isolated, unloaded, and human-controlled until protocol approval; AI never accepts engineering work.

assumptions.statement: Quantities, capex, OPEX, monitoring, insurance, review, removal, funding, and procurement routes are unknown.
assumptions.impact: S/M/L is complexity screening only; G7 blocks construction and no government funding is implied.

assumptions.statement: Permanent receivers, maintenance roles, annual budgets, defects periods, storage, and exit routes are unassigned.
assumptions.impact: Nothing counts as a permanent public benefit until G6 receiver sign-off; otherwise remove or return to library.

assumptions.statement: The OSM cross-check is incomplete public background under ODbL and reports a material mismatch with the provisional site polygon.
assumptions.impact: Do not use OSM as formal geometry or to block scoring; use mismatch only as an official-refresh trigger.

assumptions.statement: Any later archival image, brand, font, map, model, code, or training data needs separate rights review.
assumptions.impact: This build uses original diagrams and an OFL-licensed font; external cases are paraphrased and attributed.

assumptions.statement: The advisory in-progress secretariat is a function proposed through existing coordination mechanisms, not a new government body.
assumptions.impact: It holds no approval, enforcement, project-owner, or rail-operator authority.

assumptions.statement: The 100-day window starts only after selection, a real interface passes G0, and all required consents are obtained.
